description: Compact, diffable AI-readiness scorecard. Written by build-scorecard.mjs, tracked at .altitude/ai-readiness/runs/baseline/scorecard.json. Every score field is a real measured number from a completed run, or null ("not measured") — never fabricated.

runId.description: The run-probe.mjs runId this scorecard was distilled from, e.g. run-2026-08-25T14-32-06-494Z

harnessVersion.description: Short git SHA of the commit the scorecard was built at, or "unknown"

config.description: The run-probe.mjs invocation config: fleetSize, models, tasks

status.description: "judged" = run-judge.mjs completed and overallReadinessScore/taskScores are real. "unjudged" = only the fleet phase ran; scores are null.

taskScores.description: taskId -> score (0-100) or null if that task wasn't judged. Legacy/blended field kept for schemaVersion-1 consumers; prefer treatmentScores (R3/R8) for anything treatment-aware.

treatmentScores.description: taskId -> treatment ('mcp-off'|'mcp-on'|'with-skill') -> judged score (0-100). Added schemaVersion 2 (R3/R8) so treatment arms are comparable, not blended into one number.

deterministicByTreatment.description: treatment -> non-LLM rollups straight from attempt files (R4 grader score, R6 cost/latency/axe, R5 process-assertion pass rate) — available even on an unjudged scorecard. Added schemaVersion 2.

fleetSummary.description: Pass-through of run.json's summary block: total/gradeable/void/noParse/retried counts, byModel + byTreatment breakdown

note.description: Present only on unjudged/partial scorecards — explains what's missing and why
